workarounds.symptom: delete_terminal does not take the session lifecycle lock, so a delete by id can leave a create's FIFO reader and provider behind
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(terminal): close the create and delete teardown races under the lifecycle lock (#1458, #1468). Target files: src/cli_agent_orchestrator/services/herdr_app_inbox_service.py, src/cli_agent_orchestrator/services/herdr_inbox_service.py, src/cli_agent_orchestrator/services/script_runner.py. This PR has two commits. The two fixes close the leak only together, so they ship together: - **Commit 1** (#1458): a create registers its FIFO reader and provider before it releases `session_lifecycle_lock`. - **Commit 2** ... (Ref: https://github.com/awslabs/cli-agent-orchestrator/pull/1463)

workarounds.symptom: cao worker send can run up to 60s past --timeout when one broker read stalls
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(fleet): bound the status read so a stalled broker cannot hold cao worker send 60s past --timeout (#1059). Target files: src/cli_agent_orchestrator/utils/fleet.py, test/utils/test_fleet_client.py, CHANGELOG.md. . Carries #1217. (Ref: https://github.com/awslabs/cli-agent-orchestrator/pull/1492)

workarounds.symptom: A reply that fails to deliver still counts as sent, and send_message reports success
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(inbox): report delivery failures instead of counting a reply as sent. Target files: src/cli_agent_orchestrator/api/main.py, src/cli_agent_orchestrator/backends/base.py, src/cli_agent_orchestrator/backends/herdr_app_backend.py. A worker's reply now ends its caller's wait only once the reply is delivered, and `send_message` reports whether an immediate delivery worked. A queued message that fails before typing is retried, and its sender is told if it gives up. It also turns eager delivery back on for Claude ... (Ref: https://github.com/awslabs/cli-agent-orchestrator/pull/1419)

workarounds.symptom: OMP provider: omp 18.x workers read as completed while still running (handoff tears them down)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(omp): detect OMP 18 working, ready and completion states. Target files: src/cli_agent_orchestrator/providers/omp.py, test/providers/test_omp_unit.py, docs/omp-cli.md. The OMP provider was calibrated on OMP 17.2.10. On omp 18.x a dispatched worker reads as completed while it is still running, and a handoff tears it down seconds after dispatch. With the default `composer.shape: band`, it never reaches a ready state at all. Details and a 17.x vs 18.x comparison are in #1344. (Ref: https://github.com/awslabs/cli-agent-orchestrator/pull/1345)
